name: Amenomori Rise
source:
She is a genius in the fields of programming and AI at very young age that invited to Senrai Academy City Senior High School.
A typical researcher who moves with curiosity and does not care about anything other than what she is interested in.

She loves her younger twin sister, Yui, but she is feeling lonely because she has recently been distancing herself from her.
